items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Bird going to set the riffs in the reed section, [Bob Gould] Buddy and Piggy going to set the riffs in the brass section... So consequently, we played so many head arrangements.

ctx.x: Bird going to set the riffs in the reed section, [Bob Gould] Buddy and Piggy going to set the riffs in the brass section, and when -- and the bones, you know what I mean. Sometimes got to have one bone, to have one bone, he'd have to go with the brass. If I had two bones, then they could work together. But they was -- either alternate, do it one way or the other. So consequently, we played so many head arrangements. That's where it was set. But we just sit and start playing, the rhythm section.
Now we had tunes that we would take on, tunes like "Willow, Weep for Me." We called that particular tune sport them up.
